title: Influence bound from DNF width
statement: Let $p\\in(0,1)$, let $f$ be a monotone sign-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and let $w$ be a natural number. If $f$ is represented by a disjunctive normal form whose width is at most $w$, then its total influence under the product distribution with bias parameter $p$ is at most $4(1-p)w$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a sign-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
